method: HOG handcrafted features + scikit-learn MLP (image-level PASS/FAIL classifier)
description: Baseline1 is an image-level baseline. It judges one whole image as PASS/FAIL under a single fixed expected-count vector. It does NOT output bounding boxes, per-class counts or non-catalogue boxes. Object-level outputs are exempt for this image-only baseline.

class_catalogue.size: type/spec not in catalogue (rejection label, not a sixth target class)

supported_counts_note: The fixed reference vector is the group discussion starting point [1,1,1,1,1]; it remains TBD until the 2026-11-12 group meeting confirms D07. Image-level baseline1 supports only this one fixed vector; any other vector must return status UNSUPPORTED_COUNTS with empty predicted_label and prediction_score.

preprocessing.resize: stretch to image_size, aspect ratio not preserved
preprocessing.normalization: HOG transform_sqrt handles gradient magnitude normalization

mlp.class_weight: balanced (applied as sample weights at fit time)

decision.score_convention: prediction_score is the MLP softmax probability of the predicted class (score_type=prob). It is an uncalibrated model probability; calibration is not claimed.

rejection.note: Image-level baseline1 does not localize or reject non-catalogue objects. ID 0 localisation/rejection is provided by the object-capable baseline3/final.

size_tolerance: N/A for image-level baseline; size verification belongs to baseline3/final (P06) and rig calibration (P01).
calibration: N/A; scale/calibration procedure belongs to P01/P06.

freeze.note: Freeze checkpoint, preprocessing, thresholds, class mapping and decision rule before Stage 3; save version/checksum and prediction files.
